context:
Goal: sessions can delete merged and temporary branches on their own.
Problem (rule): your ruling says the cloud environment carries a GitHub token named SHIV_GITHUB_TOKEN, it is not set (checked in two sessions), and branch deletes return 403; only you can create a token.
Based on (ruling): the claude-settings ruling r45 (the relay drops branch-delete pushes).
Based on (read): ten branches wait for deletion: ideas/mock-delight, ideas/mock-deputy, ideas/mock-money, ideas/mock-say-it-back, red/duo-post-pins, design-duo-post-pins, duo-post-pins, duo-post-bar-53, red/duo-post-bar-53, design-duo-post-bar-53.
Departs from: main has no such token in the cloud environment — this adds one cloud environment variable.
Waiting on: your answer; the branches stay until then.
home: claude-settings ruling r45; cloud environment settings

options.gain: Sessions delete merged and temporary branches themselves; the ten waiting branches go.
options.how: You create a GitHub token that can delete branches in this repo and add it to the cloud environment as SHIV_GITHUB_TOKEN. Never paste its value in chat.
options.label: I create the token and add it to the environment
options.lose: You make and look after one more credential.

options.how: The ten branches stay on GitHub until you delete them by hand.
options.label: No token; leave the branches
options.lose: Merged and temporary branches pile up and nobody clears them.

shown.label: I create the token and add it to the environment

title: May the cloud environment get a GitHub token so sessions can delete merged and temporary branches?
why: Your ruling already asks for it, and only you can create a token.
